chapter_seo_title: Dao-Twisted World Ch. 403: A Thousand-Year-Old National Champion & a Nation That Changes Its Name
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang meets a Great Qi National Champion who has lived over a thousand years—but nobody can agree on which dynasty they belong to.
og_title: Chapter 403 – The World Can’t Even Keep Its Name Straight
og_description: Zhuge Yuan’s secrets deepen as a noodle seller’s answer keeps changing. Heart-Pupil reality distortion is officially on the table.
twitter_description: Li Huowang’s universe just got a whole lot weirder—and it involves a thousand-year-old man and a noodle stall with amnesia.

lore_anchors.definition: An exalted title in ancient China for the highest-ranked master of a craft or art—originally used for Go players, but extended here to a cultivator of supreme skill who has survived centuries.
A rare human constitution whose ability can warp consensus reality around a core concept, making everyone’s perception change simultaneously—not illusion, but shared delusion.
The empire’s elite supernormal law enforcement body; this chapter reveals it has been infiltrated by the eunuch faction, suggesting deep systemic corruption.
A parasitic Black Tai Sui entity kept bound in Li Huowang’s cart; its presence continues to unsettle the Office members.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the noodle seller give different answers about the dynasty?
cultural_notes_faq.a: This is likely caused by a Heart-Pupil’s reality-warping ability—it changes what everyone *remembers* about the same question, so the same person gives contradictory answers.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Zhuge Yuan really a Heart-Pupil?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Not confirmed yet, but his evasive behavior and the way reality shifts around him strongly suggest he is either one or closely tied to one.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Li Huowang kill the Zuowandao woman?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He recognizes her as a trap-bait. He wants to let her live so she can lead him to Bei Feng, a more dangerous target.
